plan: Given my value of $13, I aim to bid conservatively to maximize profit. Bidding too high risks winning with a negative profit if the third-highest bid is low. A bid near my value, slightly below, minimizes potential loss. I will bid $12.9 to avoid overpaying while still having a chance to win if others undervalue their bids. This strategy balances risk and reward, ensuring I don't pay more than my item's value unless necessary.

Given my value of $12, I aim to bid slightly above it to potentially win while minimizing potential loss. If I bid too high, I risk paying more than my value. A bid of $12.1 allows me to win if others bid below my value and ensures I pay a reasonable amount if I win. This strategy maximizes profit by keeping potential losses low, considering the worst-case scenario where others bid higher.

With a value of $37, I aim to win the auction while minimizing the payment. I'll bid slightly below my valuation to ensure a profit if I win. The worst-case scenario is paying a bid close to my value, reducing profit. A bid of $35 balances winning odds and profitability, as it allows a profit margin if the third-highest bid is significantly lower. This strategy maximizes long-term profit potential by ensuring wins only when profitable.
